opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. [Cer-tiorari granted, 423 U. S. 923.] Motion of respondents for additional time for oral argument denied. Alternative request for divided argument granted. Motion of McClure & Trotter for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted.
